Open-air Norse sacred site. Field Ward, northern edge near the Trollwall. Stone cairn, twelve feet high, rune-carved. Maintained by Uthgardt and northern traders. Offerings of mead, iron, carved bone. Not a temple — no clergy, no services. A place where northmen leave things for the gods and the gods decide whether to notice. Smells of old fire and wet stone. Ground consecrated by decades of use. Nearest Watch patrol passes every forty minutes. Dark between the lamp posts. The kind of place where someone left hooded and beaten would be found at dawn by the first northman who came to pour mead on the stones.

Fortified hilltop camp, Greypeak foothills, ~40 miles north of Ravencrest Estate. Approaches: steep from south and west, gentler slope from north and east (where Bloodaxe pressure comes from). Water source: spring-fed stream 200 yards downhill (vulnerability). Robb's military challenge: assault a fortified hilltop position with scouts deployed.

Irony: a temple abandoned because the gods went quiet, now home to men abandoned because the economy collapsed.

The Sanguinius-coded angel is Selarial; the chained daemon is the corruption that took her; the Devil's Gate behind them is the threshold she did not return from. Knowledge of the second reading is restricted to Arik, the Prelate, the master sculptor, Lirien (Memory Palace), and the Empyrean. Selene does NOT know. Shi'van does NOT know. Norse-Faerunian threshold resonance for cross-campaign use: Hel's gate / Bifrost / Fugue Plane / Kelemvor's domain all overlay the literal site.
